name: Repair Cafe Woodville
description: Brand system for Repair Cafe Woodville, a volunteer-run community repair event supported by the charity Circularity. This manifest is the machine-readable index; read AGENTS.md for narrative rules.
mission: Fix broken items together with skilled local repairers, learn new skills, save money, and keep things out of landfill.

primary.name: Repair Cafe Orange
primary.note: 3.12:1 on white - accent only, never body text

secondary.name: Repair Cafe Navy
secondary.role: brand, headings, body text on light

violet.name: Woodville Violet
violet.note: Appears in the supplied Woodville wordmark instead of navy. Deviation from the master guidelines. Do not mix with navy in one lockup.

typography.displayRule: Titles are Hanken Grotesk Black, UPPERCASE ONLY. For numbers in titles, use a capital I for the numeral 1.
typography.fallbackStack: Hanken Grotesk, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

rules.reversedOn: Use the white logo on dark or busy backgrounds.
rules.clearspace: Keep clear space around any logo equal to the height of the letter R in REPAIR.
rules.supportedByPlacement: Include the Supported by Circularity logo at the foot of any marketing material, especially off-site assets.

icons.style: line, 1.75px stroke, round caps, currentColor, orange circle wrapper optional

do: Lead with the human benefit: skills, savings, less waste, community.
Be specific about what happens at an event.
dont: Do not lecture or shame people for throwing things away.
Do not use corporate jargon or hype.
keyMessages: Repair Cafes are volunteer-run community events where you can fix your broken items with skilled local repairers, learning new skills as you go.
Every Repair Cafe is powered by volunteers, and we are always looking for new repairers to share their skills and help keep items out of landfill.
Repairing together saves money, reduces waste, keeps things in use for longer, and brings people together.
With more than 2,500 Repair Cafes worldwide, find your nearest event and help create a more circular future.

accessibility.orangeButtonRule: White text on an orange fill only reaches AA-large (3.12:1). Keep label text bold and at least 16px. For text-dense or small controls prefer the navy button.
